description: Fixtures of the lesson/2 parser and checks (D-245, R0; run by R1). base.md and demo.md are valid; every bad file is base.md (or the base named) with one change and must give its code, with the 1-based line of the construct when 'line' is set (R1 may adjust a line number to its own convention, never a code; null = the whole lesson or no single line). 'file': null with pad_front_matter_bytes: build base.md with that many bytes of '# x' comment lines in the front matter. Context: context.json.

pending.description: Bad fixtures that W2-0 only describes (WAVE2 V5: one bad fixture per new code). The track writes the file as base.md with the one change, moves the entry to `bad` with its line; `needs` lists the registry names (kind:name, kind one of diagram, block, check, option) whose track makes the fixture writable: when every one is available the entry must have moved to `bad` (test/lib/lesson2_manifest_test.rb), and the manifest tests then run it like the others. Until then the code is in the registry (error_codes.yml version 20) and nothing produces it.
